versos.hebraico: הַחֲרִ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַי֙ אִיִּ֔ים וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֑חַ יִגְּשׁוּ֙ אָ֣ז יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ יַחְדָּ֖ו לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט נִקְרָֽבָה׃

controles.web: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.
controles.kjv: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
controles.livre: Calai-vos perante mim, ó terras litorâneas; e os povos renovem as forças; aproximem-se, e então falem; juntamente nos aproximemos ao juízo.

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י הֵעִיר֙ מִמִּזְרָ֔ח צֶ֖דֶק יִקְרָאֵ֣הוּ לְרַגְל֑וֹ יִתֵּ֨ן לְפָנָ֤יו גּוֹיִם֙ וּמְלָכִ֣ים יַ֔רְדְּ יִתֵּ֤ן כֶּֽעָפָר֙ חַרְבּ֔וֹ כְּקַ֥שׁ נִדָּ֖ף קַשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his foot in righteousness? He hands over nations to him, and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.
controles.kjv: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
controles.livre: Quem o chamou desde o oriente, e com justiça o chamou ao seu pé? Ele lhe deu as nações perante sua face, e o fez dominar sobre reis, e os entregou à sua espada como o pó, como a palha fina levada por seu arco.

versos.hebraico: יִרְדְּפֵ֖ם יַעֲב֣וֹר שָׁל֑וֹם אֹ֥רַח בְּרַגְלָ֖יו לֹ֥א יָבֽוֹא׃

controles.web: He pursues them, and passes by safely, Even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.
controles.kjv: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
controles.livre: Ele os persegue, e passa em segurança; por um caminho onde com seus pés nunca tinha ido.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־פָעַ֣ל וְעָשָׂ֔ה קֹרֵ֥א הַדֹּר֖וֹת מֵרֹ֑אשׁ אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ רִאשׁ֔וֹן וְאֶת־אַחֲרֹנִ֖ים אֲנִי־הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he.”
controles.kjv: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I am he.
controles.livre: Quem operou e fez isto ,chamando as gerações desde o princípio? Eu, o SENHOR, do princípio aos últimos, eu mesmo.

versos.hebraico: רָא֤וּ אִיִּים֙ וְיִירָ֔אוּ קְצ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ קָרְב֖וּ וַיֶּאֱתָיֽוּן׃

controles.web: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.
controles.kjv: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
controles.livre: As terras litorâneas viram, e tremeram; os confins da terra tremeram; eles se aproximaram, e chegaram.

versos.hebraico: אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֖הוּ יַעְזֹ֑רוּ וּלְאָחִ֖יו יֹאמַ֥ר חֲזָֽק׃

controles.web: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”
controles.kjv: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
controles.livre: Cada um ajudou ao outro, e a seu companheiro disse: Sê forte.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחַזֵּ֤ק חָרָשׁ֙ אֶת־צֹרֵ֔ף מַחֲלִ֥יק פַּטִּ֖ישׁ אֶת־ה֣וֹלֶם פָּ֑עַם אֹמֵ֤ר לַדֶּ֨בֶק֙ ט֣וֹב ה֔וּא וַיְחַזְּקֵ֥הוּ בְמַסְמְרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃ס

controles.web: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smoothes with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good”; and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.
controles.kjv: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
controles.livre: E o artífice encorajou ao ourives, o que alisa com o martelo ao que bate na bigorna, dizendo da soldagem: Boa é. Então com pregos o firmou, para que não se mova.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדִּ֔י יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּחַרְתִּ֑יךָ זֶ֖רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹהֲבִֽי׃

controles.web: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend,
controles.kjv: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
controles.livre: Porém tu, ó Israel, servo meu; tu, Jacó, a quem escolhi, semente de Abraão, meu amigo;

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶחֱזַקְתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִקְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵאֲצִילֶ֖יהָ קְרָאתִ֑יךָ וָאֹ֤מַר לְךָ֙ עַבְדִּי־אַ֔תָּה בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֥א מְאַסְתִּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant, I have chosen you and not cast you away;’
controles.kjv: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
controles.livre: Tu, a quem tomei desde os confins da terra, e te chamei desde seus mais extremos, e te disse: Tu és meu servo; a ti escolhi, e não te rejeitei.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י עִמְּךָ־אָ֔נִי אַל־תִּשְׁתָּ֖ע כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אִמַּצְתִּ֨יךָ֙ אַף־עֲזַרְתִּ֔יךָ אַף־תְּמַכְתִּ֖יךָ בִּימִ֥ין צִדְקִֽי׃

controles.web: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
controles.kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
controles.livre: Não temas, porque eu estou contigo; não te assombres, porque eu sou teu Deus. Eu te fortaleço, te ajudo, e te sustento com a minha mão direita de justiça.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן יֵבֹ֨שׁוּ֙ וְיִכָּ֣לְמ֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ יִֽהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וְיֹאבְד֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י רִיבֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.
controles.kjv: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
controles.livre: Eis que serão envergonhados e humilhados todos os que se indignaram contra ti; eles se tornarão como o nada; e os que brigarem contigo perecerão.

versos.hebraico: תְּבַקְשֵׁם֙ וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָאֵ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֖י מַצֻּתֶ֑ךָ יִהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וּכְאֶ֖פֶס אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחַמְתֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a non-existent thing.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
controles.livre: Ainda que os procures, tu não os acharás; os que lutarem contra ti se tornarão como o nada; e os que guerrearem contra ti, como coisa nenhuma.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מַחֲזִ֣יק יְמִינֶ֑ךָ הָאֹמֵ֥ר לְךָ֛ אַל־תִּירָ֖א אֲנִ֥י עֲזַרְתִּֽיךָ׃ס

controles.web: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
controles.kjv: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
controles.livre: Porque eu, o SENHOR teu Deus, te seguro pela tua mão direita, e te digo: Não temas; eu te ajudo.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּֽירְאִי֙ תּוֹלַ֣עַת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב מְתֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עֲזַרְתִּיךְ֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh, “and your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
controles.kjv: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
controles.livre: Não temas, ó verme de Jacó, povinho de Israel; eu te ajudo,diz o SENHOR e teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֣ה שַׂמְתִּ֗יךְ לְמוֹרַג֙ חָר֣וּץ חָדָ֔שׁ בַּ֖עַל פִּֽיפִיּ֑וֹת תָּד֤וּשׁ הָרִים֙ וְתָדֹ֔ק וּגְבָע֖וֹת כַּמֹּ֥ץ תָּשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.
controles.kjv: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
controles.livre: Eis que eu te pus como debulhador afiado, novo, que tem dentes pontiagudos. Aos montes debulharás, e moerás; e aos morros tornarás como a palhas.

versos.hebraico: תִּזְרֵם֙ וְר֣וּחַ תִּשָּׂאֵ֔ם וּסְעָרָ֖ה תָּפִ֣יץ אוֹתָ֑ם וְאַתָּה֙ תָּגִ֣יל בַּֽיהוָ֔ה בִּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּתְהַלָּֽל׃פ

controles.web: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in Yahweh. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
controles.livre: Tu os padejarás, e o vento os levará; e o redemoinho os espalhará; porém tu te alegrarás no SENHOR, e te orgulharás no Santo de Israel.

versos.hebraico: הָעֲנִיִּ֨ים וְהָאֶבְיוֹנִ֜ים מְבַקְשִׁ֥ים מַ֨יִם֙ וָאַ֔יִן לְשׁוֹנָ֖ם בַּצָּמָ֣א נָשָׁ֑תָּה אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶעֱנֵ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֵֽם׃

controles.web: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
controles.kjv: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
controles.livre: Os pobres e necessitados buscam águas, mas nada acham ; sua língua se seca de sede. Eu, o SENHOR, os ouvirei; eu, o Deus de Israel, não os desampararei.

versos.hebraico: אֶפְתַּ֤ח עַל־שְׁפָיִים֙ נְהָר֔וֹת וּבְת֥וֹךְ בְּקָע֖וֹת מַעְיָנ֑וֹת אָשִׂ֤ים מִדְבָּר֙ לַאֲגַם־מַ֔יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִיָּ֖ה לְמוֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the midst of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
controles.kjv: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
controles.livre: Abrirei rios em lugares altos, e fontes no meio dos vales; tornarei o deserto em tanques de águas, e a terra seca em mananciais de águas.

versos.hebraico: אֶתֵּ֤ן בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אֶ֣רֶז שִׁטָּ֔ה וַהֲדַ֖ס וְעֵ֣ץ שָׁ֑מֶן אָשִׂ֣ים בָּעֲרָבָ֗ה בְּר֛וֹשׁ תִּדְהָ֥ר וּתְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּֽו׃

controles.web: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set fir trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;
controles.kjv: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
controles.livre: Plantarei no deserto o cedro, a acácia, a murta, e a oliveira; juntamente porei na terra vazia a faia, o olmeiro e o cipreste;

versos.hebraico: לְמַ֧עַן יִרְא֣וּ וְיֵדְע֗וּ וְיָשִׂ֤ימוּ וְיַשְׂכִּ֨ילוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֥י יַד־יְהוָ֖ה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּ֑את וּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרָאָֽהּ׃פ

controles.web: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the hand of Yahweh has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
controles.kjv: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
controles.livre: Para que vejam, saibam, reflitam, e juntamente entendam que a mão do SENHOR fez isto; e o Santo de Israel isto criou.

versos.hebraico: קָרְב֥וּ רִֽיבְכֶ֖ם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הַגִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ עֲצֻמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם יֹאמַ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ יַעֲקֹֽב׃

controles.web: Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring out your strong reasons,” says the King of Jacob.
controles.kjv: Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
controles.livre: Apresentai vossa demanda!,diz o SENHOR. Trazei vossos argumentos!, diz o Rei de Jacó.

versos.hebraico: יַגִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔נוּ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְרֶ֑ינָה הָרִאשֹׁנ֣וֹת׀ מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה הַגִּ֜ידוּ וְנָשִׂ֤ימָה לִבֵּ֨נוּ֙ וְנֵדְעָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֔ן א֥וֹ הַבָּא֖וֹת הַשְׁמִיעֻֽנוּ׃

controles.web: “Let them announce, and declare to us what shall happen. Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.
controles.kjv: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
controles.livre: Tragam e anunciem-nos as coisas que irão acontecer; anunciai quais foram as coisas passadas, para que possamos dar atenção a elas, e saibamos o fim delas; ou dizei-nos as coisas futuras.

versos.hebraico: הַגִּ֨ידוּ֙ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת לְאָח֔וֹר וְנֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אַף־תֵּיטִ֣יבוּ וְתָרֵ֔עוּ וְנִשְׁתָּ֖עָה ונרא יַחְדָּֽו׃

controles.web: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.
controles.kjv: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
controles.livre: Anunciai as coisas que ainda virão, para que saibamos que vós sois deuses; ou fazei o bem ou o mal, para que nos assombremos, e juntamente vejamos.

versos.hebraico: הֵן־אַתֶּ֣ם מֵאַ֔יִן וּפָעָלְכֶ֖ם מֵאָ֑פַע תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה יִבְחַ֥ר בָּכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Behold, you are of nothing, and your work is of nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
controles.kjv: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
controles.livre: Eis que vós sois nada, e vossa obra não tem valor algum; abominação é quem vos escolhe.

versos.hebraico: הַעִיר֤וֹתִי מִצָּפוֹן֙ וַיַּ֔את מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֑י וְיָבֹ֤א סְגָנִים֙ כְּמוֹ־חֹ֔מֶר וּכְמ֥וֹ יוֹצֵ֖ר יִרְמָס־טִֽיט׃

controles.web: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come; from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name; and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.
controles.kjv: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
controles.livre: Eu suscitei a um do norte, que virá oriente, e invocará meu nome; e virá sobre os príncipes como se fossem lama, e como o oleiro pisa o barro.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־הִגִּ֤יד מֵרֹאשׁ֙ וְנֵדָ֔עָה וּמִלְּפָנִ֖ים וְנֹאמַ֣ר צַדִּ֑יק אַ֣ף אֵין־מַגִּ֗יד אַ֚ף אֵ֣ין מַשְׁמִ֔יעַ אַ֥ף אֵין־שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? And before, that we may say, ‘He is right?’ Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.
controles.kjv: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
controles.livre: Quem anunciou coisa alguma desde o princípio, para que o possamos saber, ou desde antes, para que digamos “correto é”? Porém não há quem anuncie tal coisa nem quem diga coisa alguma , nem quem ouça vossas palavras.

versos.hebraico: רִאשׁ֥וֹן לְצִיּ֖וֹן הִנֵּ֣ה הִנָּ֑ם וְלִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר אֶתֵּֽן׃

controles.web: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
controles.livre: Eu sou o primeiro que digo a Sião: Eis que ali estão! E a Jerusalém darei um anunciador de boas novas.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨רֶא֙ וְאֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וּמֵאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֵ֣ין יוֹעֵ֑ץ וְאֶשְׁאָלֵ֖ם וְיָשִׁ֥יבוּ דָבָֽר׃

controles.web: When I look, there is no man; even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask of them, can answer a word.
controles.kjv: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
controles.livre: E olhei, porém ninguém havia. Até entre estes nenhum conselheiro havia a quem eu perguntasse, e ele me respondesse algo.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן כֻּלָּ֔ם אָ֥וֶן אֶ֖פֶס מַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם ר֥וּחַ וָתֹ֖הוּ נִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: Behold, all of them, their works are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
controles.kjv: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
controles.livre: Eis que todos são falsidade, suas obras são nada. Suas obras de fundição são vento e sem valor algum.
